Ridgelines has no calendar of its own yet, so those listings come from the digest's saved research. Create a Google Calendar named 'Ridgelines' and they will get real holds too.
Drive times are rough estimates from the Burlington area. Times marked 'time not confirmed' were assumed from a venue's usual schedule, not published.
